<!-- The following table presents the design ground motions for different service levels (return periods) and confidence levels in terms of peak ground accelerations $PGA=S_a(0)$ in rock site conditions. -->



```{r echo=FALSE}
TR_TARGET <- c(100,475,1000,2475,5000,10000)
Vs30_TARGET <- 1100
p_TARGET <- c(0.50,"mean",0.84,0.90,0.95)
UHS <- UHSTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="openquake" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1" & TR %in% TR_TARGET]
CAP <- "Design Ground Motions in terms of peak ground accelerations PGA for return periods ranging from 100 to 10,000 years, obtained for soil site conditions with  $V_{s30}$ = %4d  m/s within a p=%s confidence level."
```


```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-PGA.site
#| tbl-cap: "Design Ground Motions (rock) - PGA[g]" 
#| column: body-outset-right
DT <- gmdp::buildTable.Sa(UHS,Tno=0,po=p_TARGET,TRo = TR_TARGET,Vs30o = Vs30_TARGET,tagUnits = FALSE)
# setnames(DT,old = c("TR[yr]","PGA[g]"),new = c("TR","PGA"))
LT1 <- DT[p==0.50,.(TR,V50=PGA)]
LT2 <- DT[p=="mean",.(TR,Vmean=PGA)]
LT3 <- DT[p==0.84,.(TR,V84=PGA)]
LT4 <- DT[p==0.90,.(TR,V90=PGA)]
LT5 <- DT[p==0.95,.(TR,V95=PGA)]

AUX <- LT1[LT2,on=.(TR)][LT3,on=.(TR)][LT4,on=.(TR)][LT5,on=.(TR)]
AUX[,Vs30:=Vs30_TARGET] 
AUX[,POE:=round(100*(1-exp(-50/TR)),2)]

AUX <- AUX[,lapply(.SD,function(x){
          if(is.numeric(x)){
            as.numeric(prettyNum(x,digits=2))
          } else {x}
        })]
AUX <- AUX |> setcolorder(neworder = c("TR","POE","Vs30","V50","Vmean","V84","V90","V95")) 

setnames(AUX,old = c("POE","Vs30","V50","Vmean","V84","V90","V95"),new = c("POE[%]","Vs30[m/s]","PGA[g] (median)","PGA[g] (mean)","PGA[g]  (84%)","PGA[g] (90%)","PGA[g] (95%)"))

AUX |> buildTable(library="gt", align.body="center",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14) 

# Fix bug in gmdp when Tno !=NULL
```
